# Separate asset authorization

The binary character models and textures in this directory are not licensed under the Harness Desktop MIT license.

The project maintainer supplied these files from a purchased asset collection and has represented that the collection is authorized for inclusion and redistribution in this repository. Keep the maintainer's purchase and authorization records outside the public repository.

Downstream users must not assume that the MIT license grants separate rights to reuse, resell or redistribute these character assets. Questions or verified rights-holder requests should be directed to the repository maintainer; affected assets can be removed independently without changing the open-source application code.
